conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: If those neural "roads" get damaged, it can disrupt the communication between brain regions, potentially leading to impairments in function depending on where the damage occurs.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: For instance, a stroke can damage specific neural pathways, affecting speech or motor control.
